translation.name: YISU KILISI ANE BINGE VIE GIENGK IWAL AVOS

content: Yisu gilgum amol bage tiate ti be vie vukuri.
Yisu gisov lum mateu ane aplo gile vukuri be amol ti ebe bage tavlu tiate (gimat) ok gisov lum aplo givin gile gibweg.
Be Amolmol anongge ilgum ve indi velob Yisu nilgum amol nok bage be vie vukuri tis Sonda me ma. Eisir ilgum etok ve gisov eisir irek luev ebe ve inemb Yisu ta ok.
Yisu ginei gitangi amol ebe bage tiate ok be ginei, “Umdil be unme uvarkei ebe mate ane ik.”
Bekob Yisu giutani amolmol be ginei, “Eitit taute yaun ret givin Sonda? Tanalgum gen vie me tanalgum gen tiate tis Sonda? Tanpasang amolmol me tanes amolmol vunkunu?” Bemem eisir inei yaun ti ite.

Yisu ta vavis be gitlo eisir giwei giwei, be gili ebe iute yaun siti ite ok be ta viti ve is anongge. Bekob ginei gitangi amol bage tiate ebok be ginei, “Uto bagem!” Ei gito bage be seukie-ngge bage vie vukuri.
Parisai ili be imdil ile ihlang ikwai lum aplo be ile ivin Herodes ane amolmol subu, be kakie gipil luev ebe ve ines Yisu vunu ok.
Amolmol anongge iro sut isov bui kapul ile
Yisu tis ane singamolomb-gen ikwai nam etok be ivang bui kapul Galilaia ane be amolmol anongge itaumul ei be ile. Eisir nok nangge Galilaia be nangge Juda,
be Jerusalem tis Idumia, be nangge bui Joldan tavlu ane, be Taia tis Saidon as nam dabe subu givin. Eisir iute gen ebe Yisu gilgum ok binge, beti itangi Yisu ile.

Yisu gilgum amolmol anongge utlas vie vukuri be eisir ebe gimat gitun is tiate tiate molge ok isu isate itangi Yisu ile ve bais nile ei. Beti Yisu ginei gitangi ane singamolomb-gen ve indi eivovo ti be insu ei tis eivovo nok nile nivwev aikawe nikwai alus veik amolmol inde insung-sungi ei ge bwaya.
Be amolmol ebe ngalau tiate ivang ivin is ok ili Yisu be ikari is ate ile itak itak nalk gideb Yisu na ane be yayai be ital yaun avos bambamo-ngge be inei, “Pomate ane Natu mie.”
Beti Yisu geb yaun gwang-ne molge gitangi ngalau tiates nok ve ginei intal ei are vusa bwaya.
Yisu geb ane amolmol kulkul ane gitangi 12
Bekob Yisu gireu matendubi ti gile be gital eisir 12 ebe ei tang givin ve inalgum ei ane kulkul ok, be itangi ei ile.
Yisu geb amolmol 12 etok ile ivarei bekob ginei gitangi eisir be ginei; “Ayeu gab yem ve unemb kulkul unvin ayeu, be atob ayeu naro yem ta be unbul amolmol ve Pomate ane yaun (mateu).
Be atob ayeu namb gwang-ne nitangi yem ve unaitin ngalau tiates nikwai amolmol nivin weik etok ge.”
Yisu geb ane singamolomb-gen 12 etok be gital ares ginei Aposel. Be eisir nok ares eteik: Saimon, (be Yisu gital are ti Pita),
be Sebedi natu-nggen Jems gabu Jon. (Be Yisu gital sulu ares ti ginei Boanesis weik walpap, ve sulu ivang be avos bambamo sinsin ge).
Be Endru gabu Pilip, be Batolomai gabu Matai, Tomas gabu Alapai natu Jems be Tadai gabu Saimon.
Be Judas Iskariot ebe asonge nitak Yisu nisov amolmol valir ane bais ok.
Yisu be tis Belsebul
Yisu ginumul gile ane nam ebe giengk ok vukuri be amolmol anongge iro isate sut ile ipil dongke vukuri. Be Yisu tis ane singamolomb-gen ve inen ben bemem sawa ma molge.
Beti Yisu tine be tis male-nggen iute yaun etok be inme ve inggas ei, ve amolmol inei dang-etok inei gen ti wat gilgum ei.
Gidung subu ebe emb Mose ane yaun dabin ok nangge Jerusalem inme be inei Belsebul givang givin Yisu. Belsebul etok Sadam are ti be ei ngalau tiate as tamas.
Beti Yisu gital amolmol be itangi ei ile be ginei ve bingai gitangi eisir be ginei; “Sadam gitangi ebe nitin ei ate ok ite ma.
Be nam dabe ti ginei inemb isate vusa be ines isate atob amolmol inambweg vie ite.
Eisir vu ti ginei inemb isate vusa atob inambweg vie ite weik etok ge.
Be ginei Sadam ane amolmol-gen ok ines valir nitangi isate be inemb isate vusa nile dubi ailu, atob eisir indi isate weik eisir vu dongke ite ma.”

“Amol ti gitangi nisov amol lai ti ane nam aplo nile be nivwat amol etok ane wambal nikwai ite. Ei nidgin amol lai etok ta nikwai okob atob nisov amol nok ane nam aplo nile be nivwat ei ane wambal nikwai.”
“Bingano, Ayeu nanei bingano-ngge nitangi yem. Pomate atob nisin amolmol as tiate ebe ilgum be inei ok nikwai,
bemem amolmol ebe ital Sadam are gipil Pomate ane Ngalau Yamar ok, ete Pomate atob nisin eisir as tiate etok nikwai ite ma yapin.”
Yisu ginei yaun etok gitangi eisir, ve gisov gidung subu ebe emb Mose ane yaun dabin ok inei Yisu gitin ngalau tiate gikwai amolmol ve Sadam ane gwang-ne.
Yisu tine be tis male-nggen.
Yisu tine be tis male-nggen ile ve indi ei be ivarkei ebe sagin dume ok ge be emb yaun gile ve Yisu. Eisir tas givin ve Yisu ninme nile eisir kob.
Amolmol anongge imbweg meidbul Yisu love sawa ma molge. Bekob ete amol ti ginei gitangi Yisu be ginei, “Tinem be tis am male-nggen ete ande inme ok ve indi mie, be ete ivarkei sagin dume ivarkei ok.”
Be Yisu ginei gitangi amolmol tepwengge be ginei, “Ayeu anei angg bambamo-nggen lavo itangi yem be unaute kob.”
Yisu na giro amolmol bambamo ebe imbweg meidbul ei ok ta be ginei, “Awangg bambamo-nggen yem nok ete tepwengge etenik.
Amolmol ebe tas givin Pomate ane yaun be ilgum ei ane kulkul ok, eisir etok ete awangg bambamo-nggen.”
